symptoms: Vibration rose from 3.0 to 7.6 mm/s over 10 days; DE bearing temperature 88 C
action_taken: Replaced DE and NDE bearings (BRG-6208); checked alignment
root_cause: Lubricant degradation and contamination at DE bearing
recommendation: Shorten oil change interval to 2000 h; add weekly vibration route

symptoms: Discharge temperature 104 C with pre-alarm; frequent unloading
action_taken: Cleaned oil cooler and after-cooler fins; replaced oil filter
recommendation: Monthly cooler cleaning in dry season

symptoms: Vibration 6.4 mm/s at 1x running speed; audible beat
action_taken: Cleaned blades and performed field balancing
recommendation: Inspect blades quarterly; check water treatment drift

symptoms: Misfire alarm cylinder 7; power reduced 8%
action_taken: Replaced spark plugs set (SPK-GE15)
root_cause: Spark plug electrode wear beyond limit

symptoms: Belt tracking to one side; edge damage observed
action_taken: Re-aligned tail pulley and adjusted training idlers
root_cause: Tail pulley shifted after material spillage
recommendation: Add spillage cleaning to daily checklist

symptoms: Steady drip from seal gland about 20 drops/min
action_taken: Replaced mechanical seal cartridge (SEAL-MS45)
root_cause: Seal face wear after dry running event

symptoms: Pitch battery low-voltage alarm; turbine stopped
action_taken: Replaced pitch battery pack blade 2

symptoms: Oil filter dP alarm; oil darker than normal
action_taken: Replaced oil filter and topped up oil
recommendation: Align filter change with 2000 h service

symptoms: Loading/unloading at wrong set points
action_taken: Recalibrated pressure transmitter
recommendation: Include transmitter in annual calibration plan

symptoms: Vibration 5.2 mm/s at 2x running speed; coupling insert debris
action_taken: Replaced elastomeric coupling insert and re-aligned
recommendation: Laser alignment after every motor removal

symptoms: Oil pressure dropped to 3.2 bar at full load
action_taken: Replaced oil filter; checked pressure relief valve
recommendation: Trend oil pressure vs. filter dP

symptoms: Squealing noise; hot idler at return side
action_taken: Replaced 3 return idlers
recommendation: Upgrade to sealed idlers in dusty zone

symptoms: Oil traces on gearbox base; level slightly low
action_taken: Replaced output shaft oil seal; topped up gear oil
recommendation: Replace gearbox seals during annual shutdown

symptoms: Gearbox oil temperature 82 C; power curtailed
action_taken: Cleaned gearbox oil cooler; replaced thermostat

symptoms: Crackling noise; discharge pressure fluctuating
action_taken: Cleaned suction strainer; operations raised tank level
recommendation: Add strainer dP to operator rounds

symptoms: Main motor tripped on overload at high ambient
action_taken: Checked motor windings and terminals; cleaned motor fins
root_cause: High ambient plus dirty motor cooling fins

symptoms: Vibration 7.9 mm/s and DE bearing temperature 90 C
action_taken: Replaced DE bearing; changed oil; checked alignment
root_cause: Probable lubrication starvation (low oil level found)
recommendation: Install oil level sight glass alarm; daily level check

symptoms: Jacket water 97 C at full load
action_taken: Cleaned radiator core; replaced coolant

symptoms: Discharge temperature 106 C; oil temperature 89 C
action_taken: Cleaned coolers; replaced thermostatic valve element

symptoms: Belt drifting; skirt rubber worn
action_taken: Re-trained belt; replaced skirt rubber
recommendation: Modify chute liner to centre load

symptoms: Oil traces in air receiver drain
action_taken: Replaced air/oil separator element

symptoms: Flow reduced about 12% at same speed
action_taken: Replaced impeller wear ring

symptoms: Vibration 5.8 mm/s; scale on two blades
action_taken: Cleaned and re-balanced fan

symptoms: Rattle noise near fan deck
action_taken: Torqued fan stack and deck bolts
recommendation: Add bolt torque check to quarterly PM

symptoms: Whistling noise; boost pressure slightly low
action_taken: Inspected turbocharger; cleaned compressor wheel

symptoms: Grinding noise during yaw movement
action_taken: Greased yaw bearing and checked yaw brake pads

symptoms: Oil level below sight glass minimum
action_taken: Topped up compressor oil; checked for leaks
root_cause: Minor leak at oil return line fitting

symptoms: Drive motor overload at full belt load
action_taken: Cleared spillage; checked motor current balance

symptoms: Vibration 4.9 mm/s at DE; no temperature rise
action_taken: Tightened baseplate bolts; vibration reduced to 3.4 mm/s
